+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Parameter
+from .core import ParameterSource
+
+
+class ExplicitNullOption(Parameter):
+    """A :class:`~click.core.Parameter` that treats a name present in
+    the parsed options with a ``None`` value as an explicit command line
+    value, instead of falling through to the environment, the default
+    map, or the default.
+    """
+
+    def consume_value(
+        self, ctx: Context, opts: cabc.Mapping[str, t.Any]
+    ) -> tuple[t.Any, ParameterSource]:
+        if self.name in opts and opts[self.name] is None:  # type: ignore
+            return None, ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE
+
+        value = opts.get(self.name)  # type: ignore
+        source = ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE
+
+        if value is None:
+            value = self.value_from_envvar(ctx)
+            source = ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+
+        if value is None:
+            value = ctx.lookup_default(self.name)  # type: ignore
+            source = ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+
+        if value is None:
+            value = self.get_default(ctx)
+            source = ParameterSource.DEFAULT
+
+        return value, source

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import click
+from click.core import ParameterSource
+from click.explicit_null_option import ExplicitNullOption
+
+
+class _Param(ExplicitNullOption):
+    param_type_name = "parameter"
+
+    def _parse_decls(self, decls, expose_value):
+        return decls[0], list(decls), []
+
+
+def _make(**kwargs):
+    return _Param(["value"], **kwargs)
+
+
+def test_explicit_none_is_commandline():
+    param = _make(default="d", envvar="EXPLICIT_NULL_VALUE")
+    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"), default_map={"value": "m"})
+    assert param.consume_value(ctx, {"value": None}) == (
+        None,
+        ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE,
+    )
+
+
+def test_value_from_opts():
+    param = _make(default="d")
+    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"))
+    assert param.consume_value(ctx, {"value": "x"}) == (
+        "x",
+        ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE,
+    )
+
+
+def test_missing_falls_through(monkeypatch):
+    param = _make(default="d", envvar="EXPLICIT_NULL_VALUE")
+    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"), default_map={"value": "m"})
+    monkeypatch.setenv("EXPLICIT_NULL_VALUE", "e")
+    assert param.consume_value(ctx, {}) == ("e", ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("EXPLICIT_NULL_VALUE")
+    assert param.consume_value(ctx, {}) == ("m", ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP)
+    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"))
+    assert param.consume_value(ctx, {}) == ("d", ParameterSource.DEFAULT)
notes:
Added ExplicitNullOption(Parameter) in a new module whose consume_value mirrors Parameter.consume_value (same signature, no decorators, no super() call in the base) but returns (None, COMMANDLINE) immediately when self.name is present in opts with a None value; added unit tests covering explicit None, normal values, and env/default_map/default fallthrough.
